title: Inference GPU PostgreSQL Native authority contract

request.arguments: UTF-8 JSON object passed as the second text argument; maximum 1 MiB
request.action: First text argument; one member of actions; action-specific exact key sets, types, and closed enums are enforced
request.uow: Runs inside and borrows the caller's transaction; never commits or opens a transaction

arguments.description: At most one selector may be non-null; both null lists all registry rows, a resource selector lists its members, and a backend selector reads one registry row.

caller_native.transaction: Borrows caller-owned workflow transaction; exposes only bounded administrative actions and public facts.

request.request_id: outer request UUID for owner correlation

reply.settled: false when the session is already unknown or expired

dispatch_http.session_semantics: Owner-process in-memory context only; expiry/shutdown settles as uncertain, never stopped; no durable result/stop ledger.

admin_http.transport: JSON request/response bodies; models reject undeclared fields

owner_protocol.name: GPUAuthorityData and GPUAuthorityDataProvider
owner_protocol.native_calls: Caller supplies one action and its finite argument object; provider dispatches only to the two declared authority functions.
owner_protocol.transaction: Caller supplies the UOW; Native functions borrow its transaction, never commit or open a transaction. Lock order is resource advisory lock, membership rows by backend UUID, fence rows by backend UUID, then plain registry reads. Registry rows are not locked to avoid inverse registry/resource lock order.
owner_protocol.security_boundary: Native projects only finite membership, fence, rollout, proof, residency and diagnostic facts. It never projects endpoint_subject, request_id, endpoint URL, auth method/token or private credentials; endpoint capture/opening and token signing remain separate live owner capabilities. Health and Redis effects run in the owner while its caller transaction remains open.

collector_native.security_boundary: The proof carries only endpoint_sha256 and a bounded residency DTO, never endpoint_subject, request_id, URL, auth material, or private credentials.
collector_native.transaction: Caller-owned UOW remains open while the owner verifies the Redis receipt and collection evidence. Lock order is resource advisory lock, membership row, fence row, then plain registry read. Prepare returns receipt_required or proof_valid; commit sets the exact transaction-local GC receipt only after receipt verification, deletes only the exact retiring membership, and deletes its fence only when the registry is absent.

positive_decimal.description: Canonical positive int64 decimal string; upper bound 9223372036854775807.

nonnegative_decimal.description: Canonical nonnegative int64 decimal string; upper bound 9223372036854775807.
